title: NIST WebBook: Carbon monoxide is CO, molecular weight 28.0101 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Carbon monoxide as CO, molecular weight 28.0101 amu, CAS 630-08-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Carbon monoxide, CAS Registry Number 630-08-0, lists molecular formula CO and molecular weight 28.0101 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 27.9949146 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CO/c1-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
